summary: Iteration 31 — verified wallet earnings pipeline. Backend: chat gift now credits recipient DIAMONDS (price/10), leaves recipient coins untouched, deducts sender coins, writes gift_ledger + wallet_tx rows for both sides. Paid-practice unlock deducts buyer, credits partner in coins AND writes wallet_tx for both sides. GET /market/wallet, /market/gifts (received/sent), /market/transactions (coin/diamond) all reflect changes. Fixed one blocking backend bug (missing user_card import in market.py) that would have 500'd GET /market/gifts. Frontend: verified feature-wallet appears in profile grid and opens coins-screen showing Coin balance (775) and Diamond balance (0); paid-practice-switch and gift-gate-switch render as the pill AppSwitch component; chat/[id].tsx correctly wraps both call bubbles and sticker bubbles with withAvatarRow using the same showAvatar rule as text messages (partner avatar on first message of a consecutive run). 5/6 backend tests PASS (1 skipped — 402 insufficient-coin path could not be reproduced without draining Diego's coins; code path is trivially guarded).

minor.issue: Was throwing NameError: user_card not imported. Fixed by adding to the from models import list in routes/market.py

Consider seeding an incoming-sticker + incoming-call message in the mei↔diego conversation so the UI change is trivially reproducible in demo mode (currently the presence depends on prior demo runs).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/market.py imported user_public but used user_card in /market/gifts — fixed. Would have 500'd the wallet 'Gifts received/sent' tab; catch this earlier with a lint pass.
chats.py CHAT_GIFTS price table and diamonds=round(price/10, 2) match the spec exactly.
practice.py wallet_tx for both sides labeled 'Paid practice from {buyer}' and 'Unlocked practice with {partner}' — consistent with acceptance criteria.

success_rate.frontend: verified via UI probe (wallet grid item, coins-screen, both AppSwitches) + code review for chat avatar grouping

rca_of_issue: GET /market/gifts NameError RCA: market.py used models.user_card without importing it. Root cause: partial refactor where gift_history was added after the import list was fixed. Mitigation: added user_card to the `from models import ...` line. Reproducible with a single authenticated GET /api/market/gifts before the fix.
